name: False Advertising
overview: Scripture clearly condemns falsehood and deception, emphasizing that God cannot be mocked and that every person will reap the consequences of their actions, including dishonesty (Galatians 6:7). Believers are called to put away lying and speak truthfully to one another, reflecting their unity in Christ and the transformation from their old sinful nature (Ephesians 4:25; Colossians 3:9). Moreover, holding firmly to sound doctrine equips Christians to both encourage and refute those who promote falsehood, underscoring the importance of truth in teaching and daily life (Titus 1:9).
